scenes.title: Keeping time
scenes.subtitle: Strum on the beat.
lines: In this lesson, you'll learn to strum on the beat — the foundation of rhythm.

scenes.heading: Feel the beat
lines: Rhythm matters more than fancy chords.
Tap your foot to the beat — it's the steady pulse of every song.
The metronome clicks every beat, with a stronger click on beat 1.
Strum exactly on each click, and let it guide your hand.
You're doing great, one beat at a time.
Let's start with a simple strumming pattern.
Strum down on every metronome click for four beats, keeping time at 70 beats per minute.
Let's start with a simple strumming pattern.
Four downstrokes per bar, changing from G to D on beat one.
Tap to the steady pulse, and let the metronome guide your hand.
Now, play along — the app is listening.
